environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 application deployed on Azure App Service (Linux, B1 tier) behind Azure Front Door with Standard tier. A custom Rules Engine rule is configured on the Front Door profile that appends response headers on all routes matching pattern /api/profile/*. The rule action adds header 'Content-Security-Policy' with value "default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'" using the 'Append' action with 'overwrite if exists' set to true. Additionally, the Azure App Service has a web.config transform that sets X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses. The Front Door WAF policy (Standard_AzureManagedRuleSet 2.1) is associated but in Detection mode only for managed rules - it logs but does not block. The CSP header injection happens at the CDN edge layer before response reaches client.

config.front_door: Azure Front Door Standard tier with Rules Engine
